mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2.0% in the prior month, it signals monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The joint increase in federal funds rate above 1.5% and unemployment rate above 5.0% signals a dual shock of monetary tightening and labor market weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both FEDFUNDS > 1.5% and UNRATE > 5.0%, or interaction term p-value > 0.05 in regression.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-pandemic recovery regime, a sustained increase in residential construction permits above 1.5 million units signals strong housing market activity that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods during post-pandemic recovery when HOUST > 1.5 million, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A declining trend in the unemployment rate over the prior 3 months indicates a strengthening labor market that increases consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE has declined over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.5% in the prior month, it signals a tight labor market that may trigger inflationary pressures and central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The joint increase in residential construction permits above 1.5 million units and industrial production above 105.0 indicates synchronized expansion in housing and manufacturing sectors, boosting economic growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST > 1.5 million and INDPRO > 105.0, or interaction term p-value > 0.05 in regression.

mechanism_narrative: In the early supply recovery phase, a rising industrial production index above 105.0 indicates improving manufacturing output that boosts corporate capacity utilization and earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods during early supply recovery when INDPRO > 105.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
